compatibility_dimensions.name: appearance_choice_compatibility
compatibility_dimensions.rule: Player-authored choices must remain within authorized biological and visibility constraints.

compatibility_dimensions.name: renderer_compatibility
compatibility_dimensions.rule: Renderer support may be supported, partial, unsupported or unknown without invalidating the Character.

compatibility_dimensions.name: equipment_visual_compatibility
compatibility_dimensions.rule: Visual fit/occlusion may be assessed without granting, consuming or mutating equipment.

state_rules: Unknown or source-unspecified anatomy remains unknown; no human/humanoid default is synthesized.
Current Form is an authoritative PPIA-05 projection and gates applicable appearance choices.
A valid Character remains valid when a renderer is partial, unsupported or unknown.
Hidden Forms, markers and biological facts are permission-filtered before appearance derivation, rendering, export and AI context.
Equipment preview is a permission-safe projection only and never changes Asset ownership, equipment state, Resources or inventory.
Presets store portable authored appearance choices and renderer preferences, not source-owned biology.
Randomization changes only eligible player-authored choices; source-owned morphology, hidden state and equipment ownership are excluded.
Every visual state has a semantic nonvisual representation; color is never the only state carrier.
